title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — General Assessment #20

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these animals is an amphibian? (1 mark)
   A. Snake
   B. Tortoise
   C. Toad
   D. Goat

2. Which of these is a problem caused by friction? (1 mark)
   A. Lighting a match
   B. Braking a bicycle
   C. Walking safely
   D. Wearing away of shoes and tyres

3. Why is it important to protect wild animals and their homes? (1 mark)
   A. They are dangerous to all people
   B. They do not need food
   C. They are part of nature and bring visitors to Kenya
   D. They can be sold cheaply

4. A flat sheet of paper falls slower than a stone because (1 mark)
   A. The stone is bigger
   B. Air pushes up on the flat paper more
   C. Paper is bigger
   D. Gravity does not pull paper

5. Which of these is an invertebrate? (1 mark)
   A. Snake
   B. Earthworm
   C. Goat
   D. Frog

6. Why must we conserve water? (1 mark)
   A. Water is always free
   B. Water is not needed
   C. Fresh water is limited
   D. Water never ends

7. Why do wet clothes dry faster in the sun? (1 mark)
   A. The heat evaporates the water
   B. The sun adds water
   C. The sun makes water colder
   D. The sun makes them heavy

8. What can leak from old batteries and pollute soil and water? (1 mark)
   A. Harmful chemicals
   B. Sweet juice
   C. Clean water
   D. Milk

9. Which of these needs friction to work? (1 mark)
   A. Skating on wet ice
   B. A rolling wheel
   C. Sliding on oil
   D. Walking on the ground

10. Why should you chew your food well? (1 mark)
   A. It makes food smaller for easier digestion
   B. It makes food heavier
   C. It makes food colder
   D. It stops you drinking water

11. Which of these is a use of heat? (1 mark)
   A. Cooking food
   B. Hearing sound
   C. Making light only
   D. Making shadows

12. Which of these is the best question to ask first when you sort an animal into vertebrate or invertebrate? (1 mark)
   A. Is it dangerous?
   B. Is it big?
   C. Is it fast?
   D. Does it have a backbone?

13. Why does a mango fall from a tree? (1 mark)
   A. Light pulls it
   B. Gravity pulls it down
   C. Sound moves it
   D. Friction pushes it

14. What happens to light when it hits an opaque object? (1 mark)
   A. It becomes sound
   B. It passes through completely
   C. It is blocked
   D. It becomes heat only

15. What should you do when you see a leaking tap at school? (1 mark)
   A. Play with it
   B. Open it wider
   C. Ignore it
   D. Tell an adult so it can be fixed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe how a wheelbarrow makes work easier and how it is looked after. (4 marks)

17. Give three ways of protecting water sources. (3 marks)

18. Give three ways of caring for animals. (3 marks)

19. State two dangers of leaving waste in the environment. (2 marks)

20. Describe how you can show that a liquid takes the shape of its container. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Toad
   Toads have moist skin and start life in water.

2. D — Wearing away of shoes and tyres
   Friction wears surfaces away.

3. C — They are part of nature and bring visitors to Kenya
   Wild animals are part of our environment and bring income through tourism.

4. B — Air pushes up on the flat paper more
   Air pushes up more on the wide flat sheet.

5. B — Earthworm
   An earthworm has a soft body and no backbone.

6. C — Fresh water is limited
   Only a small part of the world's water is fresh and usable.

7. A — The heat evaporates the water
   Heat makes water turn to vapour.

8. A — Harmful chemicals
   Old batteries have harmful chemicals.

9. D — Walking on the ground
   Walking needs grip from friction.

10. A — It makes food smaller for easier digestion
   Chewing breaks food into small pieces.

11. A — Cooking food
   Heat cooks food.

12. D — Does it have a backbone?
   The backbone decides the group.

13. B — Gravity pulls it down
   Gravity acts on every object.

14. C — It is blocked
   Opaque objects do not let light pass.

15. D — Tell an adult so it can be fixed
   Reporting leaks helps save water.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: The wheel rolls so friction with the ground is small. It is easier to push than drag a load. Oil the joints and wheel axle to reduce friction.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for wheel, 1 mark for less friction, 1 mark for oil, 1 mark for care.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Plant trees near rivers, do not throw waste in water, do not wash in springs, keep animals away from drinking sources.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give food and clean water, provide shelter, keep their homes clean, treat sick animals, do not beat them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Blocked drains and floods, disease from flies and rats, harm to animals, injuries from glass.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each danger.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pour 200 ml of water into a tall glass and then into a wide bowl. The shape of the water changes but the amount stays the same.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the two containers, 1 mark for shape changing, 1 mark for the volume the same.
